settings.supervisor.title: Supervisor: its rules for {{place}}
settings.supervisor.why: A rule reads: when this count reaches n here, do this. Answers alone in a row counts the go-ons that took only solicited answers, and a go-on with your word resets it. Failed sessions on a quest count since Try again. The service did not answer counts the tries of one run. Moves to another choice counts a quest's moves in a day. A line that waits for you goes on by Go on with this answer, Try again or Go on now.
settings.supervisor.count.failures-on-ch: Failures in a row on one choice
settings.supervisor.count.quiet: It went quiet and was stopped
settings.supervisor.count.moves: Moves to another choice a day
settings.supervisor.act.weighted: Go to the next by weight
settings.supervisor.upToReferred: The supervisor may wait for the reset at most
settings.supervisor.note.failures-on-cho: Driven lines only; it acts before failed sessions do.
settings.supervisor.note.tries: Driven lines; a conversation keeps its own five tries.
settings.supervisor.none: {{place}} holds no rules of its own; its lines read the wider place's.
settings.supervisor.always: Always: a rule acts between turns only; it never ends a running or quiet session and never answers a question.
settings.supervisor.consequence: Saving puts this to work at once for every line here; a line waiting now waits until you go on.
settings.supervisor.role.some: Its moves to another choice and their bound are supervisor rules naming this role; change them in the supervisor's rules.
settings.supervisor.role.none: Its moves to another choice follow the supervisor's rules for every role; to set them for this role alone, add a rule for it in the supervisor's rules.
